newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish High Court blocks U2 rock concerts.
newsitem.headline: Irish High Court blocks U2 rock concerts.

text.p: Ireland's High Court on Monday blocked two concerts by Irish rock supergroup U2 at Irish Rugby Football Union grounds in Dublin, saying the events were illegal under planning laws.
But the court granted a stay of the order until Wednesday to allow an appeal to the Supreme Court.
More than two million Irish pounds ($2.9 million) worth of tickets had already been sold for the concerts at the end of August. ($ = 0.683 Irish Pounds)
